Healthy, adult, male 19 55 years of age, inclusive, at the screening. 2. For elderly subjects(Part A Cohort 5 only), healthy, elderly, male or female (of nonchildbearing potential only) over 60 years of age, inclusive, at screening. 3. In the case of the elderly(Part A Cohort 5 only), they have a history of milddisease, but can participate if the researcher judges that they can stop taking thedrug at least 2 weeks before the expected first dose or before the half-life is 5times or more) ## Study Design Total Participants: 64 Treatment Group(s): 1 Primary Treatment: FB418 Phase: 1 Study Start date: December 20, 2023 Estimated Completion Date: December 31, 2024 ### Study Description Part A: Primary: To assess the safety and tolerability of single ascending oral doses of FB418 in healthy adult subjects and healthy elderly subjects. Secondary: To assess the pharmacokinetics (PK) of FB418 and metabolite after single ascending oral doses of FB418 in healthy adult subjects and healthy elderly subjects. To assess the effect of a high-fat meal on the PK of FB418 and metabolite after a single oral dose of FB418 when administered to healthy adult subjects. Part B: Primary: To assess the safety and tolerability of multiple ascending oral doses FB418 in healthy adult subjects.
